notes: Zoo management is a manager loop, which is Simulation, and the author's answer that the whole server shares one zoo whose animals are unlocked with pooled points makes it the co-op tycoon rather than a per-player build: plot-shared is one right-sized plot with upgrades spread across it benefiting everyone jointly, which is what a shared zoo is, so I took the Tycoon preset intact. Its gate-progression becomes the enclosure that opens when enough points are spent, social-hub the entrance plaza and shop where they are spent, and path-circulation the clean visitor paths the author asked for. I added trigger-task for the events players take part in to earn points, and npc-population because the animals, birds and reptiles are the entire subject of the build and that row covers ambient animals and the ground they occupy — the enclosures and the visiting crowd. Decided without a user: I read "various events" as repeatable activities staged around the park rather than round-based minigames, so there is no Party & Casual genre and no lobby separated from a match area, which would have cost P4; the zoo is bright and modern per the answers and starts at six enclosures, a count this form has nowhere to put, so it is recorded here; and I left interiors out, so a walk-in aviary or reptile house is the one upgrade that would add P3 later.
